candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order POST /v1/orders returns HTTP 500, so the order service is the failing origin of the checkout errors.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs/traces and the specific order failure (dependency vs internal) are not in evidence; only the gateway's view of the 500 is observed.

report.explanation: Every checkout 502 correlates with a gateway client call to order returning 500 in logs and traces; topology confirms gateway->order dependency. Root cause is bounded to order service returning 500, but the underlying order-side fault is not yet observed.
